templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Addendum that layers AI-specific terms onto an existing agreement, covering use of AI services, customer data handling, model training restrictions, and allocation of responsibility for AI output.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: HIPAA Business Associate Agreement setting out a provider's obligations and restrictions when handling protected health information on a covered entity's behalf, including safeguards, breach notification, and subcontractor terms.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for a subscription cloud/SaaS product, covering access and use rights, customer data, security, payment, warranties, indemnification, and limitation of liability.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: Data processing terms addressing controller, processor, and subprocessor relationships, international transfers, security measures, and data subject rights under privacy regimes such as GDPR.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for early-stage collaboration in which a design partner receives pre-release product access in exchange for structured feedback, covering IP in that feedback and confidentiality.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
templates.description: Standard terms of a two-way confidentiality agreement, defining confidential information, permitted use and disclosure, exceptions, term, and return or destruction obligations. Pairs with the MNDA cover page.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
templates.description: Fill-in cover page that completes the Mutual NDA by capturing party details, the purpose of disclosure, term, and governing law, and incorporating the MNDA standard terms by reference.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Terms for a commercial partnership between two companies, covering each party's cooperation obligations, referral or resale arrangements, trademark use, revenue terms, and confidentiality.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Terms for a time-limited paid or unpaid pilot, covering access during the pilot period, success criteria, conversion to a full subscription, and what happens to data when the pilot ends.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Master terms for delivering professional services under statements of work, covering service delivery, customer responsibilities, acceptance, fees and expenses, IP in deliverables, and termination.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Service level commitments for a hosted product, covering target uptime, how downtime is measured and excluded, support response times, and service credits as the remedy for missed targets.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Terms for licensing software delivered to the customer rather than hosted, covering the license grant and restrictions, deployment scope, maintenance and support, audit rights, and IP ownership.
